title: Here Are the 2026 ACM Awards Winners: Full List
summary: Ella Langley swept her seven nominations, including female artist of the year.
contentText:
Ella Langley swept every prize she was nominated for at Sunday night’s (May 17) 2026 Academy of Country Music Awards, going seven-for-seven on the night, including female artist of the year.

The top prize of entertainer of the year went to Cody Johnson, who also won male artist of the year earlier in the evening.

Related

Here's Why Megan Moroney Won't Be at the ACM Awards Sunday Night

Paul McCartney Performs 'Band on the Run,' 'Coming Up' & 'Days We Left Behind' on 'SNL' Season Finale

The ACM Awards were back in Las Vegas, at the MGM Grand Garden Arena, after the last three years at Ford Center at The Star in Frisco, Texas. They also had a brand-new host in country superstar Shania Twain, who took over after repeat host Reba McEntire the past two years.
